title: Nvidia is buying Hugging Face for almost $13 billion

Hugging Face is an online platform founded in 2016 that gives AI developers a space to share their projects and data with other users and the general public. It's often described as the "GitHub" for AI due to its browsable library of open-source machine learning models and emphasis on community collaboration features.

summary: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a leading open-source AI platform, for $12.93 billion. The deal will unite Hugging Face's vast library of AI models and datasets with Nvidia's hardware dominance, potentially accelerating AI development and accessibility.

title: Researchers fear safety disaster ahead of OpenAI’s Astra release
content:

As details about the model trickle out, researchers are warning it "may be the single worst development for AI security/safety to date."
Shortly after OpenAI said on Tuesday that it had delayed Astra's release to work on safety issues, The Information reported that Astra shows far less of its "thinking" than other frontier AI models, sparking concern it could be dangerously hard to monitor.
Most top AI systems today are built using a technology known as a tra …

summary: OpenAI is preparing to release Astra, its most advanced AI model yet, but researchers warn it poses significant safety risks due to opaque decision-making and potential for harmful agent behavior. The model's delayed launch highlights ongoing concerns about AI security and transparency in frontier systems.

title: Nvidia launches free tool that links idle computers into a personal AI data center

It's open-source software developed by Nvidia that discovers compatible PCs on a network, connects them, and prepares them for crunching numbers on agentic workflows. This week, the Trump administration filed a statement of interest in the case, supporting OpenAI's argument that it's fair use to train an AI model on copyrighted text.

summary: The U.S. economy added a stronger-than-expected 162,000 jobs in August, indicating a recovering labor market. This jobs report is crucial as the Federal Reserve weighs potential interest rate adjustments at its upcoming September policy meeting.

title: Kalshi US visits soar 1,500% as regulatory pressure mounts
content: Kalshi’s US web traffic climbed more than 1,500% in less than a year, while trading volume grew even faster and legal scrutiny of its sports contracts intensified.
summary: Kalshi, an online exchange, has seen a dramatic increase in US web traffic, soaring over 1,500% in less than a year, with trading volume growing even faster. This rapid expansion is occurring amid intensified legal scrutiny of its sports contracts.
